title: A lantern picnic
scene: Overhead scene of Puppy sleeping on a checked blanket beside three lanterns, a flower vase and ROB's hands arranging the lantern handles.
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Produce ONE original finished portrait children's coloring-book illustration, not a montage. Preschool ages 3-5: large easy-to-color closed spaces, broad shapes, expressive animation-quality drawing. ROB is a friendly original robot with a wide rectangular riveted head, two large round eyes with SIMPLE EMPTY CONCENTRIC CIRCLES (no stipple or texture), tiny smile, boxy chest, articulated claw hands and two caterpillar tracks (no human legs), NO antenna. Puppy is a small floppy-eared dog with plain collar. Include only characters named in the scene, never add ROB when it says no robot. Draw specifically the described action and viewpoint with natural interaction, not stock standing front view. Coherent scene, 4-6 main elements, big shapes and broad outlines. Fill most of portrait 2:3 page while keeping white margin. SCENE: Overhead scene of Puppy sleeping on a checked blanket beside three lanterns, a flower vase and ROB's hands arranging the lantern handles.
